tools.name: search_signals
tools.description: US ecommerce brands flagged on the latest day for a change in their Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads: newly advertising, scaling, struggling or stopped, with store platform, live ad count and other ad channels. Defaults to new and scaling brands in every niche the caller's plan covers. Without signing

tools.name: lookup_brand
tools.description: Is this store running Meta ads? Finds the Facebook page behind a store domain and returns advertising since, live ads, trend (new, scaling, stable, stopped), channels and store platform. Signed in: catalog size, price range, recent launches and store age (free plan: 5 new domains a day); Pro and up

tools.name: check_store
tools.description: Store platform (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, other store or not a store), catalog size, price range and store age for a domain, plus the tracking pixels and marketing tools on its homepage (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, Klaviyo, Triple Whale and more). Results under a day old are reused

tools.name: reveal_brand
tools.description: Unmasks one brand from search_signals on the free plan: its name, domain, store and Ad Library link. Pass the masked row's ref. Spends one of the account's 10 reveals a month (they reset on the 1st; a brand already revealed is free) and needs a signed-in free account. A revealed brand stays unmasked

tools.name: list_niches
tools.description: The niches AdvertiserLeads tracks, the signal types and filter values search_signals accepts, and what the caller's plan includes.
